items.title: Japanese Girl
items.prompt: A night street portrait of a young woman wearing an elaborate kimono in an urban setting, the furisode kimono primarily teal-green and embroidered with exquisite butterfly and floral patterns in rich layered colors from light to deep green, accented with white, pale blue, and gold flowers and lifelike colorful butterflies. One large blue-black butterfly is especially prominent at the center of the hem, surrounded by intricate patterns of cherry blossoms, plum blossoms, and small flowers. The kimono fabric has a silk-like glossy texture. A wide brocade obi is tied at the waist with complex geometric patterns and embroidery, decorated with colorful tassels and traditional knots. She wears a refined hair ornament, her brown short hair slightly fluffy with a blue flower pinned in it. Her pose is elegant, right hand gently raised to her forehead as if feeling the night breeze or gazing into the distance, left hand relaxed at her side with fingers slightly curled, her gaze directed upward, expression calm and thoughtful, facial contours soft, makeup refined but not exaggerated, lips natural pink, overall temperament gentle yet modern. She wears beige-white wooden geta sandals with simple surfaces contrasting with the kimono, standing on a sidewalk paved with gray square tiles that reflect a faint glow. The background is a blurred city night scene with distant high-rises and flickering neon lights, warm yellow, cool white, and orange-red bokeh scattered in the darkness, modern building structures along the street, metal beams and lighting fixtures overhead, and bright white streetlamps creating an urban night atmosphere. The composition is a medium shot with the subject slightly left of center, body slightly turned, head tilted up to form graceful lines. The lens focuses on the subject with deep background blur, highlighting her details and the exquisite clothing; light comes mainly from surrounding streetlights and building lights, from the side and above, creating soft highlights and shadows on the kimono, enhancing volume and casting a faint shadow on the ground. The interwoven light and shadow create a quiet dreamlike mood. The palette is cool overall, combining teal, gray-blue, black, and warm yellow contrast, with visual focus on her face and the kimono patterns, especially the large butterfly. The composition is narrative, like a poetic moment, full of Japanese aesthetic refinement and modern urban alienation, presenting a unique mood where tradition and modernity blend, like a high-quality portrait shot with a professional camera, with strong artistic expression and emotional tension.

items.title: Kpop styles girl
items.prompt: At the center of a futuristic stage, two young women dance under vivid lights. In the foreground, a dancer in a pink cropped top and voluminous ruffled short skirt steps forward dynamically, her shoulder-length dark straight hair framing a bright smile, eyes looking toward the camera. Her top carries black artistic lettering, paired with white knee-high socks and thick-soled lace-up boots; her right arm swings naturally while her left hand holds a microphone, body leaning slightly forward with rhythmic motion. Behind her, another dancer in a white slip dress with long loose hair moves in sync, her expression cooler and lips slightly pouty, creating a contrast. They form the visual focus against a huge LED screen displaying flowing abstract geometric patterns in blue and red, with stage floor reflecting multicolored light in rippling patterns. A blurred audience in the background holds glowing light sticks, creating an energetic live-show atmosphere. The mid-shot composition, slightly low angle, blue-dominant lighting with pink and purple halos, crisp silhouettes, and saturated details capture a dynamic concert moment with immersive pop-performance energy.

items.title: Fashion Girl
items.prompt: A young woman stands in a tropical resort-style indoor bar, wearing a bright purple satin off-shoulder bodycon dress with gathered folds at the waist, a short hem ending at mid-thigh, and black pointed high heels with gold toe ornaments. She wears black gloves, her right hand hanging naturally and her left hand on her hip, confident and alluring. Her long black hair falls smoothly over her shoulders with a pink bow hair accessory; her makeup is delicate, her gaze soft toward one side, and her lips slightly curved in a languid, charming expression. Behind her is a round woven rattan chair and a cluster of colorful hand-painted directional signs reading “BEACH”, “SURFING”, “Waikiki”, “KILAUEA”, and “Bar” in rough handwritten lettering in green, yellow, red, blue, and light green, arranged along a white metal railing. To the right, a tall palm tree is lit in purple-blue, echoing the neon palette; hanging spherical lamps glow warm yellow, with white pipes and blue decorations above, pale tiled walls, and dark wooden flooring. The space is bathed in soft colored light—purple, blue, and orange-yellow—creating a dreamy, slightly迷离 nightlife atmosphere; a bright circular flare appears in the lower right foreground, adding depth and a candid, fashionable resort-party mood.

items.title: Chinese girl
items.prompt: A side-profile portrait of an elegant Eastern woman in refined Hanfu, her glossy black hair piled high with a few loose strands falling beside her ear, adorned with simple classical hair ornaments. Her face is delicate, brows and eyes finely drawn, her gaze deep and faintly melancholic toward the right side of the frame, lips gently pressed in a quiet, introspective expression. She wears an ivory cross-collar ruqun, a vivid red wide silk ribbon tied in an elegant bow at her chest with two ends hanging down, contrasting with a red velvet cloak embroidered with gold floral motifs and edged by a thick, soft white fox-fur collar. Her hands rest lightly before her abdomen, fingers slender and neatly manicured. The composition is a half-body close view occupying most of the frame, set in an ancient interior corridor with dark wooden walls and traditional Chinese lattice windows, square warm-yellow lanterns hanging above, blurred windows and architectural outlines in the distance. Soft light enters from the left and above, modeling her face, shoulders, and cloak with gentle transitions and deep but unobtrusive shadows; the warm lantern glow contrasts with cooler surroundings, creating a quiet, story-rich classical atmosphere.

items.title: Cyber Racer
items.prompt:
A young man crouches on a gravel driveway in front of an orange sports car with the sun flaring behind it.

Subject: A young man with dark hair and a short beard wearing dark sunglasses.

Clothing: He wears a bright orange bomber jacket covered in black graffiti-style text, a black t-shirt underneath, loose black cargo pants, and chunky orange and black sneakers.

Action: The subject is crouching low to the ground, looking directly at the camera with a neutral expression, his hands resting near his knees.

Environment: The setting is a residential driveway paved with small grey stones, with a large red brick house featuring chimneys in the background and green trees visible behind the car.

Camera: Shot from a slightly low angle to emphasize the subject's pose, utilizing a wide-angle lens that captures the full width of the car and the surrounding environment.

Lighting: Strong backlighting from the sun creates a bright starburst flare over the car's windshield, casting long shadows on the gravel and highlighting the texture of the jacket.

Style Details: The image has a high-contrast, slightly grainy aesthetic typical of film photography with vibrant orange tones dominating the color palette.

items.title: Girl
items.prompt:
A close-up selfie of a young woman with blonde-highlighted hair in a messy bun, wearing an Argentina national football team jersey and holding a Starbucks drink to her lips.

Subject: A young woman with fair skin, dark eyes, and blonde highlights in her brown hair styled in a high messy bun. She has defined eyebrows, long eyelashes, and is looking directly at the camera with a playful expression while sipping from a straw.

Clothing: She wears a white and light blue vertical striped Argentina football jersey featuring the AFA crest on the left chest and the number 10 in black on the front. The jersey has black trim around the neckline and sleeves, and she wears a gold cross earring and a delicate gold necklace with a small pendant.

Action: She is holding a clear plastic cup containing an iced coffee beverage with a green straw to her mouth, tilting her head slightly back as she takes a sip. Her left hand grips the cup firmly while her right arm extends forward in a selfie pose.

Environment: The background shows a large professional football stadium filled with spectators during a match. A green pitch is visible with players on the field, and advertising boards displaying YPF logos line the perimeter of the field.

Camera: Shot as a close-up selfie with a shallow depth of field that blurs the stadium crowd and field in the background to emphasize the subject's face and upper body.

Lighting: Bright natural daylight illuminates the scene evenly, highlighting her facial features and creating soft shadows within the jersey folds.

Objects: A clear plastic Starbucks cup filled with an iced coffee drink and a green straw is held in her left hand.

Text/Graphics: The Argentina Football Association crest is visible on her chest, the number 10 is printed on the front of her jersey, and a blue wristband with white text reading ARGENTINA is worn on her left wrist.

Style Details: High-resolution photography with vibrant colors and sharp focus on the subject against a blurred stadium backdrop.

items.title: Ocean Night Dream
items.prompt:
A young woman sits gracefully on dark, barnacle-covered rocks by the ocean at night.

Subject: A young woman with long, dark hair cascading over her shoulders and a soft, gentle smile directed at the camera.

Clothing: She wears a vibrant pink, floor-length gown featuring intricate white floral lace detailing across the bodice and sleeves, paired with dangling earrings and a delicate necklace.

Action: She is seated with her hands clasped gently in her lap, leaning slightly forward with a relaxed posture.

Environment: The setting is a rocky shoreline at night, with dark ocean waves crashing softly behind her against a pitch-black sky.

Camera: Shot from a medium-full angle with a shallow depth of field that keeps the subject sharp while softly blurring the background rocks and water.

Lighting: Illuminated by a focused artificial light source that highlights her face and gown against the deep shadows of the night, creating a high-contrast, moody atmosphere.

Style Details: High-resolution real photograph with rich color saturation and a cinematic nighttime aesthetic.

items.title: Princess Birthday
items.prompt:
A young woman with long dark wavy hair wearing a silver tiara and a pink dress sits at a table with a pink birthday cake in front of her.

Subject: A young woman with long dark wavy hair wearing a silver tiara and a pink dress sits at a table with a pink birthday cake in front of her.

Clothing: She wears a light pink off-shoulder dress with puffy sleeves, a delicate necklace, and a sparkling tiara on her head.

Action: She rests her chin on her hand, looking directly at the camera with a soft smile.

Environment: The setting is decorated for a celebration with white balloons, a large pink bow in the background, tall pink candles with bows, crystal glasses, and a pink frosted cake with lit candles.

Camera: Shot from a medium close-up angle with a shallow depth of field that blurs the background slightly to emphasize the subject.

Lighting: Warm ambient light highlights her face and the glowing candle flames create soft reflections on the scene.

Style Details: The image has a dreamy, romantic aesthetic with a pastel color palette dominated by shades of pink and white.

items.title: Chinese Girl
items.prompt:
摄影风格：冷白清透CCD生活照风 
写真方向：都市艺术生活写真 
场景方向：美术馆外大台阶 / 极简白色石材 / 户外雕塑区 
服装方向：黑灰色修身削肩背心 + 燕麦色高腰针织包臀短裙 
气质标签：清冷、知性、克制、高级、轻微纯欲 
五官方向：真实清冷淡颜，干净高级，不网红 
五官细节：偏窄鹅蛋脸，面部轮廓利落但不锐利，面中轻微饱满；细长清亮杏眼，眼神安静克制；鼻梁流畅挺直；唇形自然克制，低饱和裸粉色；整体有高级耐看感，不幼态，不甜妹化 
发型方向：黑色长发自然披散或低扎，发丝顺滑，脸侧少量碎发，整体利落 
身形方向：轻盈纤细，上围饱满自然 
线条强调：强 镜头方向：大腿及上半身 
姿态动作：站在台阶边缘，身体轻微侧向镜头，双手自然放在身前 
光线氛围：冷白日光主导 + 石材反射光 + 极弱柔闪 
滤镜效果：冷白高光 + 低饱和蓝灰CCD色彩 + 轻颗粒 + 轻数码噪点 
画幅比例：9:16 
补充要求：削肩背心自然突出肩颈、锁骨、胸线，针织短裙强调腰臀衔接与修长比例，人物要清冷耐看，有都市艺术气质

items.title: Sakura Girl
items.prompt:
subject: an adult Chinese woman in her mid-20s, smooth pale skin, delicate oval face, dark expressive eyes, soft matte rose-red lips, delicate lashes, elegant collarbones, and long silky black hair
超写实电影级人像摄影。竖幅9:16构图。低角度仰拍，聚焦于人物面部。拍摄对象站在春日盛开的樱花树下。柔和的自然光透过枝叶，在脸庞、颈项和白色T恤上投下斑驳的光影。略显凌乱的头发随风飘动，几缕发丝在微风中摇曳。拍摄对象仰望天空，神情宁静而梦幻。肌肤柔和透亮，妆容自然，纹理逼真，双眸栩栩如生。使用85mm人像镜头拍摄，浅景深，奶油般的背景虚化，前景和背景中樱花花瓣的柔和虚化。明亮轻盈的氛围，柔和的粉彩色调，透过枝叶隐约可见的蔚蓝天空。自然光，高动态范围，电影级光线，头发上细腻的高光，柔和的阴影过渡，逼真的肌肤纹理，微妙的电影级色彩调校，梦幻般的春日氛围，充满情感的叙事性摄影。前景花朵部分遮盖画面，景深强，构图层次丰富，专业人像摄影，捕捉自然瞬间，展现生活方式类杂志美学，细节极其丰富，品质卓越，照片级真实感，逼真的镜头虚化，顶级相机品质。无过度修图，无美颜滤镜，无夸张妆容，无奇幻效果，无卡通风格，无额外配饰，无面部或身体改变。精确参考风格：仰视，樱花盛开，柔和的阳光透过树叶，梦幻般的春日氛围，浅景深，电影般的自然人像，写实摄影。
